description:
Outcome: Gardener sees their plot and season dates, from brief.md First version must 3
Scope: Accessible phone page with own allocation, awaiting decision and waitlisted states. Excludes: others contact details and map
Acceptance: Reload shows current own assignment and configured season dates; no-allocation states clear; tampered household ID cannot expose another household
Behaviour: Login expiry, error/retry and accessible status messages
Verification: Gardener E2E including unauthorized household identifiers. Prerequisites: T-006, T-003. Assumptions: none
title: Gardener allocation and season view
